scope: Read-only; selected live configuration and metadata; fixed 25-object CloudTrail content sample; no host execution, traffic captures, raw event retention or cloud changes

sharedContentSample.scope: Fixed sample of at most 25 objects: five latest CloudTrail objects per maintained region; request/response fields scanned in memory only

classification.note: Access-key identifiers and session tokens are documented STS logging behavior; no secretAccessKey payload detected. Pattern-based sample does not establish absence elsewhere.

approvalBoundary: Owner explicitly approved shared-bucket metadata and content. Automatic review rejected the full 13522-object content scan; approved fixed 25-object alternative completed.
limitations: Current parameter policy is not a reread of rendered host configuration.
No raw Docker, journal, CloudWatch, SSM output or queue bodies inspected.
Name/tag ownership filtering does not comprehensively cover untagged resources.
Security Hub InvalidAccessException is unverified integration status; Zurich Detective unavailable.
CloudTrail content sample is recent and includes audit activity; arbitrary encodings and older secrets are not excluded.
